## Runs 6–7 — spot-check read and fan design gate
Run 6 is the electron point n=+3.2e12 cm^-2, run 7 the hole point n=-1.2e12, both D≈0 under the run-5 region-A calibration. Raw Rxx is shown first, using sr1_X/(sr0_X/-1e6); neither trace approaches its 5 kOhm full scale. Both have oscillatory structure, but frequency assignments remain provisional: electron peaks near 7, 15, 22 and 29 T are susceptible to a harmonic-comb interpretation, while the hole-side low-frequency peaks vary with extraction window. Do not count these as independent pockets yet.

The default electron onset read is censored at 0.3 T, in a region sampled at 50 mT; that region fails Nyquist for F_L=33.1 T. Restricting to the adequately sampled B>=1 T segment still gives a censored onset at 1 T. Per landau-fan step 1, acquire a cheap fine-grid low-field extension before fixing fan B_lo. Prefer the electron density interval near 2–3.2e12 for the fan: it spans the model's discriminating regime, whereas the permitted hole D=0 line ends near -1.27e12 in the close-pair regime. Absolute density retains the geometry scale uncertainty; the second CNP ridge remains a spatial-density confound. These single-density spectra do not yet support a stacking verdict.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, plot_raw, sdh_onset, sdh_fft
root=Path.cwd()
fig,axs=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(15,8))
for row,i in enumerate((6,7)):
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(i)); B=r.col('magnet_field'); R=r.col('sr1_X')/(r.col('sr0_X')/-1e6)
 order=np.argsort(B); B=B[order];R=R[order]
 axs[row,0].plot(B,R,'.-',ms=2);axs[row,0].set(title=f'Run {i} raw Rxx',xlabel='B (T)',ylabel='Ohm')
 axs[row,1].plot(B,R,'.-',ms=3);axs[row,1].set(xlim=(0,2),ylim=(R[B<2].min()-2,R[B<2].max()+2),title='Low-field raw',xlabel='B (T)')
 for lo in (0.7,1,1.5,2):
  f,s=sdh_fft(R[:,None],B,b_range=(lo,8),nfft=4096,bg_degree=3,log=False)
  axs[row,2].plot(f,s[0]/s[0].max(),label=f'{lo}-8 T')
  p,_=find_peaks(s[0]);p=sorted([j for j in p if 3<f[j]<50],key=lambda j:s[0,j],reverse=True)[:5]
  print(i,lo,[(round(f[j],2),round(s[0,j],2)) for j in p])
 axs[row,2].set(xlim=(0,50),xlabel='F (T)',title='FFT, degree 3, normalized');axs[row,2].legend()
fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spot_handoff.png',dpi=150)
for i in (6,7):
 r=open_run(root/'data'/str(i)); R=r.col('sr1_X')/(r.col('sr0_X')/-1e6)
 print(f'Run {i}: onset on adequately sampled B>=1 T segment')
 print(sdh_onset(R,r.col('magnet_field'),b_lo=1.0,r_full_scale=5000).summary())
plt.show()

## HERA — resolve censored onset before the Landau fan

> **05:20** · SdH onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0, B .3->1.6 T, 340 uniform-1/B points, base T, Si=0, sr1 5 uV · **ETA ~05:55** (≈35 min)

The requested stacking fan follows `landau-fan-vti` and `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4. Run 6's electron onset is censored; its 50 mT low-field segment fails Nyquist for F_L=33.1 T, so `landau-fan` step 1 requires this short `sdh-spot-check` extension before fixing the fan's B_lo. Repeat the same n=+3.2e12, D≈0 point with uniform inverse-field sampling; Δ(1/B)=0.00799 T^-1 gives >3 points/period even at 1.2 F_L, versus undersampling below 1 T previously.

Read-only preconditions check the card's exact validators, fresh base thermometry, heaters off, Si=0, fixed wiring, excitation and settling. Use sr1=5 µV (500 Ohm full scale, >9× the run-6 maximum in this window); retain tau=0.3 s, 24 dB/oct, and the magnet's >=3 s dwell. Run 6 timing is 7.46 s per 10 mT step: subtracting the 4.38 s bare ramp gives 3.08 s/point overhead. Thus 340×3.08 s + 1.6/0.137 minutes =29.1 minutes; allow overhead margin in the ETA. The magnet starts near zero, moves monotonically, and ends at 1.6 T for the fan decision. Check the first points for clipping/leakage and again halfway; stop on bad thermometry, >1 nA gate current or 90% full scale. Interrupt prevents subsequent setpoints but does not halt an active VTI supply ramp; that requires operator action.

# sdh-spot-check: resolve the censored electron onset before pricing the fan.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB
import numpy as np
# Preconditions and gate B: read-only until every check passes.
for p, expected in [(k_tg.volt,(-0.3,1.0)),(k_bg.volt,(-1.3,2.0)),
                    (dc205.smart_voltage,(-25.,25.)),(dc205.voltage,(-25.,25.)),
                    (magnet.field,(-10.,10.)),(heater.sample_setpoint,(0.,100.)),
                    (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,(0.,100.))]:
    actual=(float(p.vals._min_value),float(p.vals._max_value))
    print(p.full_name,'validator expected',expected,'actual',actual)
    assert actual==expected
assert B_SESSION_CAP==10 and T_SESSION_CAP==100
for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
_Ts,_Tv,_B=T_sample(),T_vaporizer(),magnet.field()
print('Expected base Ts 1-1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K, B~0; actual',_Ts,_Tv,_B)
assert 1<=_Ts<=1.5 and _Tv<1.6 and abs(_Ts-_Tv)<0.6 and abs(_B)<0.05
print('Expected heaters off; actual',heater.sample_range(),heater.vaporizer_range())
assert heater.sample_range()==0 and heater.vaporizer_range()==0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
print('Expected Si 0 V, range 2, output 1; actual',k_si(),dc205.voltage_range(),dc205.output())
assert abs(k_si())<0.01 and dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1
assert WIRING=={'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2','sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print('Expected drive 1 V / 13.777 Hz, tau .3 s / 24 dB; actual',sr1.amplitude(),sr1.frequency(),sr1.time_constant(),sr1.filter_slope())
assert abs(sr1.amplitude()-1)<1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency()-13.777)<0.01
assert sr0.time_constant()==sr1.time_constant()==0.3 and sr0.filter_slope()==sr1.filter_slope()==24
assert k_tg.volt.step==k_bg.volt.step==0.005 and dc205.ramp_rate==0.5
assert k_tg.nplci()==k_bg.nplci()==1
assert magnet.settle_s>=3
CAL=dict(c_tg=2.796e-3,c_bg=2.161e-3,n_offset=-0.0894,D_offset=-0.013)
_vt,_vb=calc_gate_voltages(3.2,0.,**CAL)
k_tg.volt.validate(float(_vt)); k_bg.volt.validate(float(_vb))
B_vec=field_invB(0.3,1.6,340)
for b in B_vec: magnet.field.validate(float(b))
sr1.sensitivity(5e-6)  # 500 Ohm FS; run 6 <=55 Ohm over this window
mc=dict(meas_config); mc.update({'Si (V)':0.,'sample_temperature:':_Ts,
    'comments':'electron onset extension n=3.2e12 D=0 run-5 cal, B=.3..1.6 T uniform 1/B 340 points; sr1 5 uV; settle >=3 s'})
s=sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment('onset extension: n=+3.2e12 cm^-2 D=0; B .3->1.6 T, 340 uniform-in-1/B points, Vsi=0; run-6 shared density, 5 uV FS')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt,float(_vb)); s.ramp(k_tg.volt,float(_vt)); interruptible_sleep(10)
# [time, B, Ts, Tv, Itg, Ibg, X0, P0, X1, P1]
for p in (T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P):
    s.fp(p); s.plot('time',p)
def onset_guard(station,data):
    a=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    if (not np.all(np.isfinite(a)) or not 1<=a[2]<=1.5 or a[3]>=1.6
        or max(abs(a[4]),abs(a[5]))>1e-9 or abs(a[8])>0.9*5e-6):
        print('ONSET CHECK STOP',a); station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(onset_guard,())
result_onset=s.sweep(magnet.field,B_vec,delay=0)
print('ONSET EXTENSION END',result_onset.id,'interrupted',result_onset.metadata.get('interrupted'))
print('Actual B/gates',magnet.field(),k_tg.volt(),k_bg.volt())

## HERA — Step 3: SdH spot check, electron side (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0 → 10 T

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
